I couldnt find an answer on this:

What happens if you search for a card with Sybil's tongue that isnt
there.
Does it "fizzle"? Do you still pay the cost? Do you shuffle?can you
freak at for after it?

W

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Wouter Kuyper wrote:
> What happens if you search for a card with Sybil's tongue that isnt
> there.
> Does it "fizzle"? Do you still pay the cost? Do you shuffle?can you
> freak at for after it?

It doesn't "fizzle" per se, since you did indeed get to search.

You paid the cost before you searched.
You shuffle after your search is complete.
You may Freak.
